invariants: customer_id in orders must match customer_id in customers
order_id in orders must match order_id in order_items
order_id in orders must match order_id in invoices
product_id in order_items must match product_id in products
stock_quantity in products must be ≥ 0
status in orders must be one of ['pending', 'confirmed', 'shipped', 'cancelled']
quantity in order_items must be ≥ 1
unit_price in order_items must match price in products
invoice_number in invoices must be unique
total_amount in invoices must equal the sum of (quantity × unit_price) for all order_items in the order
created_at and updated_at in orders must be valid timestamps (non-null, forward progression)
customer_id in customers must be unique
name in customers must not be null or empty
email in customers must be valid (contain @ and a domain) and not null
phone in customers must be null or contain only digits
name in products must not be null or empty
description in products must be null or not exceed 500 characters
price in products must be ≥ 0
category_id in products must match id in categories
name in categories must not be null or empty
stock_quantity in products must be ≥ 0 when the order is confirmed (stock is reserved)
order_items must not contain products with stock_quantity = 0 when order is confirmed
invoice_number must not be null when order is confirmed
